baseline.observed: Check Point discovery enumerate job 7a487c9e-979e-4563-b9e5-0f0d8d7942c6 failed with UNKNOWN_FAILURE because non-interactive SSH does not export $MDSVERUTIL without login shell environment, and ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter catches the query exception, discarding details and defaulting to UNKNOWN_FAILURE.
baseline.what_exists: ManagementShellCommands.domainList() currently returns 'source /etc/profile.d/CP.sh; $MDSVERUTIL AllCMAs'. In Gaia, non-interactive SSH sessions do not load /etc/profile or MDSVERUTIL unless executed through a bash login shell ('bash -l -c'). When execRead fails, ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter returns a generic Failed without failureClass or detailed message, causing DiscoveryJobExecutor to fall back to UNKNOWN_FAILURE.
